None was both created before March 2026 and has exactly 5 members, so I didn't archive anything.

for ch in C_GENERAL C_FOUR C_RANDOM; do
  total=0; cursor=""
  while :; do
    if [ -z "$cursor" ]; then
      resp=$(curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.members" -d "token=<TOKEN>" -d "channel=$ch" -d "limit=100")
    else
      resp=$(curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.members" -d "token=<TOKEN>" -d "channel=$ch" -d "limit=100" -d "cursor=$cursor")
    fi
    n=$(echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)['members']))")
    total=$((total+n))
    cursor=$(echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('response_metadata',{}).get('next_cursor',''))")
    [ -z "$cursor" ] && break
  done
  echo "$ch members: $total"
done
